content.text: The CI failures come from stale generated files: the merged Python lockfile update needs a new benchmark parity digest, and the Go dependency update needs regenerated notices. I also verified that the flagged setup-python SHA matches the v7.0.0 release tag. I’m fixing those files, then updating branches in dependency order.
